name: geo-quest
description: GeoQuest - Multiplayer Geography Puzzle Game for team meetings

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
